in_marathi.name: Debabrata
in_marathi.long_meaning: Debabrata हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deba (God) + Brata (gift) – The name Debabrata is a combination of two words, Deba meaning God and Brata meaning gift. This name is given to a child who is considered a gift from God.
